impact.text: The vulnerability allows the attacker to break the core accounting invariant `balance == address(this).balance`, resulting in the contract becoming insolvent.

precondition_sources.text: The attacker is an unprivileged plain contract requiring no special roles.

intent_sources.text: The contract balance state variable MUST equal the actual ETH held by the contract (balance == address(this).balance).
